Speaker: Hon. Thomas Simpson Spkoule.
Tuesday, August 18, 1914.
The Parliament which had ibeen prorogued from time to time to the 28th day of August, 1914, met this day at Ottawa, for the despatch of business, pursuant to proclamation of His Royal Highness the Governor General.
